items.item_text: Active Registered Nurse license in the State of California
Basic Life Support (BLS) certification - American Heart Association
Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certification - American Heart Association
Minimum of an Associates Degree in Nursing
Minimum of two (2) years of experience in the area of ICU nursing.

As our ICU Float Pool RN, you will help clinical teams maintain high-quality patient care across our intensive care units so they can ensure positive outcomes and a healing environment for our most vulnerable patients.

Every day you will assess, plan, and provide specialized nursing care to critically ill patients in a flexible, fast-paced environment. You will be expected to rapidly adapt to different ICU settings, monitor complex physiological changes, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and provide timely interventions to stabilize patients.

To be successful in this role, you will possess keen assessment skills, acute critical thinking, and a patient-first mindset, driven by a profound enthusiasm to help others. Your sense of urgency and dedication to excellence in a fast-paced environment will not only support patient recovery but also fuel your own career advancement.
